services.name: Microsoft 365 (admin center)
services.note: This public endpoint only shows whether the Microsoft 365 admin center itself is reachable for admins — NOT whether Exchange, Teams, or SharePoint are down for users. It's a partial/backup signal. Real per-service, per-tenant status still requires Microsoft Graph (ServiceHealth.Read) with an app registered in Entra ID.

services.name: Adobe (Creative Cloud & Document Cloud)
services.note: Uses Adobe's internal (undocumented) status feed, not an official public API, filtered to only Creative Cloud and Document Cloud incidents. If Adobe changes this feed's structure, it fails to 'no data' rather than a false 'operational'.

services.name: DocuSign
services.note: DocuSign migrated to a new status portal (Next.js/Rootly-based) that doesn't expose a stable public JSON API like the old Statuspage.io one did — the previous integration broke when they switched. Their new site's data endpoint is tied to a build ID that changes on every deploy, making it too fragile to automate reliably. Check manually via the link.
